blocks.text: Reina Filipinas titleholders Alexie Brooks and Anne Patricia Lorenzo Diaz confessed that they knew Michelle Marquez Dee will also compete at MGI All Stars even before the public learned about it. In an interview with Inquirer Entertainment at the sidelines of their recent live-selling engagement for Jojo Bragais Shoes, the two queens said they got excited upon learning that there will be another competitor from the Philippines, and it was the 2019 Miss World and 2023 Miss Universe veteran. “I’m very happy, I’m very excited [because] when I competed in Miss International Queen Philippines and Miss International Queen, one of my […]...
